Turkey, Greece & Egypt Tours & Vacation Packages 2026–2027

blocks.text: Three countries in one trip can sound ambitious, but Turkey, Greece, and Egypt fit together surprisingly well when the route is given enough time. Istanbul, Athens, and Cairo provide three very different starting points, while longer itineraries can add Cappadocia, the Greek islands, and a journey along the Nile.

Our Turkey, Greece & Egypt Tours range from 10 to 21 days. The shorter routes concentrate on the main cities and historical sites; with more time, the trip can expand to include places such as Cappadocia, Ephesus, Pamukkale, Santorini, Mykonos, Luxor, and Aswan.

Arrangements vary by itinerary and can include hotels, guided sightseeing with local guides, airport transfers, domestic and regional flights, ground transportation, Greek ferry connections, and a Nile Cruise in Egypt. Private Tours, Small Group Tours, and Customized Tours are available on selected programs.

sections.heading: Turkey, Greece & Egypt Tours at a Glance
What Makes This Three-Country Route Work?

blocks.text: The value of this trip is not simply being able to say you visited three countries. It is the contrast between them.

You might begin among the Ottoman and Byzantine landmarks of Istanbul, move on to classical Athens and a few days in the Greek islands, then finish in Cairo before travelling south along the Nile. The history changes, the landscape changes, and so does the pace of the trip.

The connections are also manageable. Regional flights link the main cities, while domestic flights, ferries, road transfers, and the Nile Cruise are used where they make sense within each country. That allows more of the available time to be spent in the destinations rather than travelling between them.

sections.heading: What Can You See with the Time You Have?

blocks.text: With around 10 days, the route needs to stay focused. Istanbul, Athens, and Cairo give you a genuine introduction to all three countries without trying to squeeze every major destination into the same holiday.
At around 16 days, there is more room to move beyond the capitals. Cappadocia or additional destinations in Turkey can be combined with Greece and Egypt while keeping the overall route manageable.

With 21 days, the trip can cover much more ground. Turkey can include several of its classic stops, Greece can include island time, and Egypt can continue beyond Cairo to Luxor and Aswan, with a Nile Cruise included on selected itineraries.
The important difference is pace. An extra five days should give you more time in places worth staying, not simply five more stops.

sections.heading: From Turkey to Greece, Then Egypt

blocks.text: The order matters on a trip like this.

Turkey is often the first part of the journey, with Istanbul providing good international connections and domestic flights making it practical to continue to Cappadocia or western Turkey. The route then moves into Greece, usually through Athens before continuing to the islands where included.
Egypt normally follows Greece by air. From Cairo, longer itineraries continue south to Luxor and Aswan by domestic flight and Nile Cruise arrangements.
Not every tour follows exactly the same sequence, but keeping the route moving in one general direction helps avoid unnecessary backtracking.

sections.heading: Islands or More Time in Egypt?

blocks.text: This is one of the decisions worth making before choosing a longer itinerary.

If Santorini or Mykonos is high on your list, allow enough time in Greece to actually stay on the islands rather than treating them as quick stops. If ancient Egypt is the bigger priority, those days may be better used for Luxor, Aswan, and a Nile Cruise.
Neither choice is better. It depends on what you would regret missing.
That is also why comparing these tours only by duration can be misleading. Two 16-day itineraries may divide their time between the three countries very differently.

Late spring and early autumn tend to give the easiest balance across all three countries. April through June and September through November generally work well for sightseeing in Turkey and Greece while avoiding the hottest part of the year in Egypt.

July and August are useful if Greek island time is a priority, but Egypt will be considerably hotter. Winter suits Egypt particularly well, although some Greek island services and seasonal tourism infrastructure operate on a reduced schedule.
For a three-country itinerary, the best month is therefore a compromise between the different climates rather than a single “best time” for the whole route.
If you have limited time, two countries may give you a better trip. Adding Egypt to Turkey and Greece makes most sense when there are enough days to give Cairo—and ideally more of Egypt—proper time.
You can compare our Turkey & Greece Tours, Turkey & Egypt Tours, and Greece & Egypt Tours if you would rather concentrate on two destinations.
If you have substantially more time, our 26-Day Turkey, Greece, Egypt & Jordan Tour continues into Jordan, adding Petra and Wadi Rum to the route.

faqs.q: Why choose a Turkey, Greece and Egypt tour?
faqs.a: A Turkey, Greece and Egypt tour combines three of the world's greatest civilizations into one seamless journey. You can experience Ottoman and Byzantine heritage in Turkey, classical Greek history and islands, and the ancient wonders of Egypt. With coordinated flights, hotels, transfers, and licensed local guides, it is one of the most rewarding multi-country vacations available.

faqs.q: How many days do I need for Turkey, Greece and Egypt?
faqs.a: Most travelers choose between 14 and 21 days. A 14-day itinerary covers the main highlights, while 18 to 21 days allows additional destinations such as Cappadocia, Santorini, Ephesus, Pamukkale, Luxor, and a Nile Cruise. Longer tours provide a more relaxed pace and deeper cultural experiences.

faqs.q: What is included in your Turkey, Greece and Egypt tour packages?
faqs.a: Our packages typically include carefully selected hotels, domestic and regional flights where specified, airport transfers, sightseeing tours, licensed local guides, entrance fees according to the itinerary, and daily breakfast. Many itineraries also include a Nile Cruise and optional upgrades for Private Tours or Customized Tours.

faqs.q: Are these tours available as private tours?
faqs.a: Yes. Every itinerary can be arranged as a Private Tour for couples, families, or friends who prefer a personalized travel experience. Private Tours offer greater flexibility, dedicated local guides, customized sightseeing schedules, and the freedom to travel at your own pace throughout Turkey, Greece, and Egypt.

Absolutely. Every itinerary can be customized to match your travel dates, interests, accommodation preferences, budget, and preferred pace. You can extend your stay, add destinations such as Mykonos, Crete, Alexandria, or Hurghada, upgrade hotels, or combine additional countries into your journey.

faqs.q: When is the best time to visit Turkey, Greece and Egypt?
faqs.a: Spring (April to June) and autumn (September to November) are generally considered the best seasons. These months offer pleasant temperatures for sightseeing, island exploration, and Nile Cruises. Summer is excellent for Greece's beaches, while winter provides comfortable weather for exploring Egypt's ancient monuments.

faqs.q: Do I need visas for all three countries?
faqs.a: Visa requirements depend on your nationality. Many travelers can enter Greece under the Schengen rules, while Turkey and Egypt have separate entry requirements. We recommend checking the latest official visa regulations before traveling, and our travel consultants are happy to provide general guidance during the planning process.

faqs.q: Are international flights between the countries included?
faqs.a: Many itineraries include regional flights between Turkey, Greece, and Egypt as specified in the tour description. Flight inclusions vary depending on the package you choose. Our team carefully coordinates flight schedules to ensure smooth connections and minimize travel time throughout your journey.

Popular itineraries include Istanbul, Cappadocia, Ephesus, Pamukkale, Athens, Santorini, Mykonos, Cairo, Luxor, Aswan, and a Nile Cruise. Depending on your available time, additional destinations such as Alexandria, Hurghada, Crete, or Rhodes can also be incorporated into a customized itinerary.

Many of our longer Turkey, Greece and Egypt Tours include a 3 to 7-night Nile Cruise between Luxor and Aswan. A Nile Cruise is widely regarded as one of Egypt's most memorable experiences, combining comfortable accommodation with visits to world-famous ancient temples along the river.

Yes. All sightseeing tours are conducted by experienced, licensed local guides in accordance with the regulations of each destination. Their in-depth local knowledge helps you better understand the history, culture, architecture, and traditions of Turkey, Greece, and Egypt throughout your journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors?
faqs.a: Absolutely. This itinerary is specifically designed for travelers visiting the Eastern Mediterranean for the first time. It combines the region's most iconic destinations into one well-balanced journey, allowing you to experience history, culture, natural beauty, and local traditions without complicated travel planning.

faqs.q: Can families with children join these tours?
faqs.a: Yes. Families regularly choose our Turkey, Greece and Egypt Tours because they combine educational experiences with enjoyable activities. We can recommend family-friendly hotels, adjust sightseeing schedules, and customize itineraries to accommodate children, teenagers, or multi-generational family groups.

Yes. Our itineraries can be arranged with carefully selected 4-star, 5-star, boutique, luxury, or premium hotels depending on your preferences and budget. We also offer luxury Nile Cruises, upgraded room categories, and exclusive services for travelers seeking a higher level of comfort.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.a: We recommend booking at least three to six months before departure, especially for travel during spring and autumn. Early booking provides the best choice of hotels, regional flights, Nile Cruises, and room availability while often securing more competitive prices for your preferred travel dates.

Since 1997, Magnificent Travel has specialized in Turkey Tours, Greece Tours, Egypt Tours, and Multi Country Tours. As a licensed local tour operator, we provide carefully planned itineraries, experienced local guides, handpicked hotels, transparent pricing, personalized service, and continuous support throughout your journey.

faqs.q: Can I combine additional destinations with this tour?
faqs.a: Yes. Many travelers extend their itinerary by adding Jordan, Morocco, or additional Greek Islands. We specialize in Customized Tours and can create a seamless multi-country itinerary that matches your interests, travel duration, and preferred style while coordinating all transportation and accommodation.

faqs.q: Why book one combined tour instead of separate trips?
faqs.a: Booking one professionally organized itinerary saves time, simplifies planning, and ensures smooth coordination between countries. Instead of arranging separate flights, hotels, and transfers independently, you benefit from one trusted local tour operator managing every aspect of your Turkey, Greece and Egypt vacation from start to finish.
